title: Opentrons COVID-19 Testing with Zymo Kit for 24 Samples
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be47jgzn
materials: Wait for the run to finish.

steps.title: Clean the OT-2
steps.instruction: Clean the OT-2 COVID-19 Diagnostic Station.

steps.title: Set up OT-2 deck labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT-2 deck in the specified slots:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Opentrons Temperature Module with an Opentrons 96 well aluminum block and an empty, sterile NEST 100 µL PCR plate
Slots 3 and 6: Full, sterile racks of Opentrons 200 µL filter tips
Slot 4: Opentrons Magnetic Module (empty)
Slot 11: Empty NEST 1-well reservoir for organic liquid waste

steps.title: Pre-cool Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Start pre-cooling the Temperature Module to 6 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sample well plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the NEST 96 deep well plate (output from Station A) containing 24 samples (#1–#24), where each well contains a sample, Proteinase K, and internal extraction control RNA, mixed.

steps.title: Prepare Viral DNA/RNA Buffer and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare 3x 14.35 mL mixtures of Viral DNA/RNA Buffer and MagBinding Beads.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile 15 mL tube, add 14 mL Viral DNA/RNA Buffer
Vortex the MagBinding Beads in their container
Pipette 0.35 mL of vortexed MagBinding Beads into the 15 mL tube
Repeat the process for a total of 3 tubes

steps.title: Prepare reagent reservoir
steps.instruction: Quickly prepare a 15 mL NEST 12 well reservoir by pipetting or pouring the following reagents, vortexing the Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads immediately before adding:

substeps.instruction: Well 1: 14.76 mL Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads (2 prepared tubes' worth)
Well 2: 7.38 mL Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads (1 prepared tube's worth)
Well 3: Empty
Well 4: 13 mL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1
Well 5: Empty
Well 6: 13 mL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2
Well 7: Empty
Well 8: 13 mL 95-100% ethanol
Well 9: 13 mL 95-100% ethanol
Well 10: Empty
Well 11: Empty
Well 12: 3 mL nuclease-free water

steps.title: Load plates and reservoirs
steps.instruction: Place the prepared plates and reservoirs onto the deck.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample well plate in slot 4
Place the reagent reservoir in slot 2

steps.title: Verify deck setup
steps.instruction: Double-check all labware for correct orientation and placement.

substeps.instruction: Ensure well A1 is at the top-left for plates
Ensure well 1 is at the left for troughs
Verify labware are properly clicked into deck slots
Verify the overall deck layout

steps.title: Run OT-2 protocol
steps.instruction: Run the Station B protocol on the OT-2 using the file StationB-24samples-Zymo-20200407.py.

steps.title: Collect output
steps.instruction: Retrieve the output NEST 100 µL PCR plate from the aluminum block atop the Temperature Module in slot 1.
